# The database

<!-- Generated by `npm run schema:doc`. Do not edit by hand:
     `schemaDoc.test.ts` regenerates this and fails if it has drifted. -->

Schema version **79**, 52 tables, read off a database built by running every migration in order.

Money is integer paise. Quantities are scaled by 10^4. Tax is basis points. A column named `*_amount`, `*_total`, `rate` or `value` is paise unless it says otherwise; `qty` columns are scaled. Nothing here is a float.

The **Sync** column is read from `domain/replicaShape.ts`, which is the one place that decision is written down, so this table cannot disagree with what a merge actually carries.

## What travels between tills

- **30 records** travel as themselves and are what the merge rule compares.
- **13 line tables** travel only inside their parent document. Half a bill is not a smaller bill.
- **9 tables stay put.** Each one has a reason, printed with it below.

  product_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id),

<details><summary>CREATE TABLE</summary>

CREATE TABLE bill_items (
  id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  bill_id         TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

  mrp             INTEGER,

  line_total      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_total >= 0),
  taxable_value   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  tax_rate_bp     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cgst_amount     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  sgst_amount     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  igst_amount     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

  returned_qty    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (returned_qty >= 0), discount_blocked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, loyalty_blocked  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cess_rate_bp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  CHECK (cess_rate_bp >= 0), cess_amount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, rate_includes_tax INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  CHECK (rate_includes_tax IN (0, 1)), batch_id TEXT REFERENCES batches(id),
  UNIQUE (bill_id, idx)
) STRICT

<details><summary>CREATE TABLE</summary>

```sql
CREATE TABLE bills (
  id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  doc_no         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  docstatus      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (docstatus IN (0, 1, 2)),
  amended_from   TEXT REFERENCES bills(id),
  register_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES registers(id),
  session_id     TEXT REFERENCES cash_sessions(id),
  customer_id    TEXT REFERENCES customers(id),
  customer_name  TEXT,
  posting_date   TEXT NOT NULL,
  subtotal       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  discount       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discount >= 0),
  taxable_total  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  tax_total      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  round_off      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  grand_total    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  paid_total     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  credit_total   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (credit_total >= 0),
  place_of_supply TEXT,
  idempotency_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  notes          TEXT,
  created_by     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  cancelled_by   TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
  cancelled_at   TEXT,
  cancel_reason  TEXT,
  rev            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  origin_id      TEXT,
  created_at     TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at     TEXT NOT NULL
, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sale'
  CHECK (kind IN ('sale', 'opening')), converted_from TEXT REFERENCES documents(id), supply_type TEXT
  CHECK (supply_type IN ('intra_state', 'inter_state')), customer_gstin TEXT, customer_address TEXT, customer_state_code TEXT, reverse_charge INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  CHECK (reverse_charge IN (0, 1))) STRICT
```

</details>

<details><summary>CREATE TABLE</summary>

```sql
CREATE TABLE documents (
  id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  doc_no          TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  kind            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('quotation', 'sales_order', 'purchase_order')),
  docstatus       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (docstatus IN (0, 1, 2)),
  register_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES registers(id),



  customer_id     TEXT REFERENCES customers(id),
  customer_name   TEXT,
  supplier_id     TEXT REFERENCES suppliers(id),
  supplier_name   TEXT,

  posting_date    TEXT NOT NULL,

  valid_until     TEXT,

  subtotal        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  discount        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discount >= 0),
  taxable_total   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  tax_total       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  round_off       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  grand_total     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

  place_of_supply TEXT,
  notes           TEXT,
  terms           TEXT,



  converted_from  TEXT REFERENCES documents(id),

  created_by      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  cancelled_by    TEXT REFERENCES users(id),
  cancelled_at    TEXT,
  cancel_reason   TEXT,
  rev             INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  origin_id       TEXT,
  created_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at      TEXT NOT NULL,

  CHECK (
    (kind = 'purchase_order' AND supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND customer_id IS NULL)
    OR (kind <> 'purchase_order' AND supplier_id IS NULL)
  )
) STRICT
```

</details>

  customer_id  TEXT REFERENCES customers(id),
  supplier_id  TEXT REFERENCES suppliers(id),

) STRICT
